title: DEPRECATED_Primitive Data Types

lines.explanation: variables of type byte can store numbers from -128 to 127
variables of type short can store numbers from -32768 to 32767
type int is a default type for integer values
type long can be used to store very big integer numbers
float type is used for floating-point numbers that do not need double precision
logic type stores one of two possible values: true and false
character type. It s values are character codes in Unicode encoding scheme
